title: Maintenance window assignment
description: schedule(request) returns separated_weight (an exact integer), windows (two lists of names), and equipment_count. Each equipment item appears exactly once, in its input order within its window. The score is the sum of requirement weights whose endpoints are in different windows; return the globally largest score. Repeated or reversed requirements contribute independently and therefore add their weights. For equal scores choose the smallest sum of 2**i over input positions i in the first window. Empty inputs return score 0 and two empty lists. Invalid requests raise ValueError; error message text is not part of the contract. Validate the entire request even after a valid prefix. Do not mutate the request. The program's JSON stdin/stdout entry point prints one response for valid requests; invalid input terminates with an error, not a success response.
